ei.subject: 2026년 3월 고2 모의고사
ei.title: Oliver's First Day at the New School

fullPassage: Looking around the noisy cafeteria, Oliver gripped his tray tightly. He felt the heavy weight of being new to the school. Not knowing how the day would go made him feel anxious. He sat with a heavy sigh at a corner table. He thought, 'Can I make it through the rest of the day?' Just then, a plastic tray was placed down opposite him. It was a boy from his math class. "Hey, is this seat taken? By the way, thanks for lending me that pen earlier." The invisible wall around Oliver seemed to melt away. "Not at all, please sit," he replied. Starting to feel at ease, he smiled brightly at the boy.

questions.passage: Looking around the noisy cafeteria, Oliver gripped his tray ①<u>tightly</u>. He felt the heavy weight of ②<u>being</u> new to the school. Not knowing how the day would go ③<u>make</u> him feel anxious. He sat with a heavy sigh at ④<u>a</u> corner table.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ make → made: 동명사 주어는 단수 취급하며, 과거시제 문맥이므로 made.
det.analysis:
✅ ① tightly: 동사 수식 부사
✅ ② being: of + 동명사
❌ ③ make → made: 시제 일치 + 단수
✅ ④ a: 가산명사 단수
det.tip: 동명사 주어 + 단수 동사. 과거시제 일치

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ melting → to melt: seem + to V 구조이므로 to부정사가 와야 한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① was placed: 수동태
✅ ② was: 단수 주어 + was
❌ ③ melting → to melt: seem + to V
✅ ④ Starting: 분사구문
det.tip: seem + to V (= appear + to V)

det.korean: ③ build(쌓다) → melt(녹다): 친구의 호의로 심리적 장벽이 '녹아 사라지는' 맥락.

det.korean: ① silent(조용한) → noisy(시끄러운): 카페테리아는 분주하고 시끄러운 곳으로 묘사된다.

✅ ② new: 원문 일치

✅ ④ corner: 원문 일치
det.tip: noisy(시끄러운) ↔ silent(조용한)
